card.title: Swedish
card.text: 75 modules from first words to C1, with grammar explained and 13 professional specializations.

heading: Learn Swedish from first words to C1.
lead: Swedish as it is spoken in Sweden, in 75 modules across eight tiers: from pronunciation, en and ett to the s-passive, nominal style, academic Swedish and the language of law and the housing market. Grammar is explained directly, and every answer gets feedback with a reason.
fineprint: The whole course, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free. Specializations, Tisus practice papers and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

panel.label: The course, tier by tier

items.title: 1 · Sounds and first words
items.text: Pronunciation, greetings, en and ett, the present tense, numbers.

items.title: 2 · Everyday basics
items.text: Definite forms, plurals, adjectives, verb-second word order, questions.

items.title: 3 · Daily life
items.text: Verb groups, modal verbs, prepositions, food, the city, shopping.

items.title: 4 · The past
items.text: The past tenses, irregular verbs, the future, reflexives, travel and health.

items.title: 5 · Building fluency
items.text: Subordinate clauses, particle verbs, comparison, the s-passive.

items.title: 6 · Intermediate
items.text: Relative clauses, the conditional, reported speech, participles.

items.title: 7 · Upper intermediate
items.text: Passives, nominal style, connectors, word formation, forms and letters from the authorities.

items.title: 8 · Advanced
items.text: Advanced word order, register and style, spoken Swedish, varieties.

panel.note: 75 modules in all. A placement test lets you start further up if you already know some Swedish.

sections.heading: A course built for adults who want to understand the language

items.title: Grammar explained, not hidden
items.text: Each grammar module states the rule: when a noun takes -en or -et, why the verb comes second, where inte goes in a subordinate clause. The grammar reference keeps every rule in one place.

items.title: Feedback that says why
items.text: A wrong answer is marked with the correct form and the reason, with a link to the rule. Answers are graded on the server, the same way every time.

items.title: Every word inspectable
items.text: Tap any Swedish word in an exercise, text or story for its meaning, its forms and audio.

items.title: Speaking with pronunciation feedback
items.text: Swedish has pronunciation assessment, so the course includes exercises where you say a sentence and get feedback on each word.

items.title: Word practice
items.text: The words you meet in the modules come back in word practice, and Vocabulary shows how many Swedish words you know against research-based CEFR estimates.

items.title: Up to real topics
items.text: The upper tiers cover politics and society, the economy, science, literature, history, law, academic Swedish and the Nordic neighbours.

sections.heading: Practice papers for Tisus
sections.intro: The course has two timed practice papers for Tisus, Stockholm University's test of the Swedish needed for university studies in Sweden.
items: Reading in the test's task types, shorter than the real part.
Writing at full length: one argumentative text in 2 hours 30 minutes, rated by AI against the Tisus criteria.
No speaking part, and no pass mark: the papers show the share of points only.

sections.heading: Swedish for your field
sections.intro: Thirteen specialization courses, each with nine modules in three stages (foundations, working vocabulary, professional) that open as you reach Tiers 4, 6 and 8 of the core course:

items.question: Is the Swedish course really free?
items.answer: Yes. All 75 modules from A1 to C1, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free, with 5 Ask AI questions a day. Premium adds the specializations, Tisus papers, stories, conversations and the other extras.

items.question: Which Swedish does it teach?
items.answer: The Swedish of Sweden. Tier 8 has modules on spoken Swedish and on varieties such as Finland Swedish and the speech of Skåne and Gothenburg.

items.question: I already know some Swedish. Do I have to start from the beginning?
items.answer: No. The placement test tells you which tier to start from.

items.question: Does it prepare for Tisus?
items.answer: It has two timed practice papers for the reading and writing parts of Tisus, and the upper tiers cover the academic and formal Swedish the test asks for. There is no speaking part, and the papers cannot tell you whether you would pass. The Tisus page has the details.

items.question: Is there a version for Finnish speakers?
items.answer: Yes. Ruotsi suomenkielisille has the same modules with explanations in Finnish, and also practice papers for the Swedish YKI test at the intermediate level.

closing.heading: Open the first module.
